name: 45504 · Springfield, OH
findings: ZIP 45504 (Springfield) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (52% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45504 (Springfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
